settings.label: Name
settings.help: The name of this computer in the environment dropdown, on the phone and on the other computers. Empty gives the name of the system.
settings.words: name rename computer environment mac label

settings.label: Show
settings.help: The computers whose agents and apps this phone shows, with a check. The computer in use always shows. Each phone keeps its own list.
settings.words: show hide isolate separate other computers environments agents apps checkbox

settings.label: Can reach it
settings.help: The other computers that cannot reach this computer, by name or public key, also when a phone introduced them. All of them can by default.
settings.words: reach link block mesh one way other computers

settings.label: Tunnel
settings.help: Reach the sites of the Mac from the phone. Off closes each tunnel.
settings.words: preview sites web localhost port remote reach tunnel
